name: Bay Alarm Medical
tagline: Affordable medical alert systems with 24/7 monitoring
daily_ok_verdict: Bay Alarm Medical is one of the lower-cost names in personal emergency response — in-home buttons, an on-the-go mobile unit, and an SOS smartwatch, all with 24/7 monitoring and optional fall detection. Even so, it is a hardware monitoring service, while Daily OK is a software daily check-in with family-first alerts. For a parent with fall risk who will wear the device, Bay Alarm covers the urgent moment Daily OK doesn't. For an independent parent who would rather not wear anything and just needs a daily 'I'm OK' that reaches family, Daily OK is cheaper still and proactive by design. Some families pair Bay Alarm's emergency button with Daily OK's daily layer.

faqs.q: Is Daily OK a replacement for Bay Alarm Medical?
faqs.a: Not for a parent who needs fall detection or 24/7 dispatch. Bay Alarm is a PERS; Daily OK is a daily check-in app. For an independent, smartphone-using parent who won't wear a device, Daily OK is often the right daily tool.

faqs.q: Bay Alarm is already cheap — why consider Daily OK?
faqs.a: Daily OK is cheaper still and, more importantly, proactive: it confirms your parent is OK every day rather than only reacting when a button is pressed. They address different needs.

faqs.q: What if my parent won't wear the device?
faqs.a: Then a PERS protects no one. Daily OK uses the phone they already carry and needs only a single daily tap.
Yes — many families do. Bay Alarm for the urgent fall moment, Daily OK for the daily confirmation it doesn't provide.
